question:
Create a new KiCad project named b32 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build a Framework USB-C microcontroller expansion card around an ATSAMD21E18A-M. Use an AP2112K-3.3 supply, a diode-isolated USB power input, an optional GD25Q16CT SPI flash, standard ARM 10-pin SWD, a reset button, and a WS2812B powered by a separately enabled TLV70036 3.6 V regulator. Include normal decoupling and USB-C CC termination, two M2 mounting holes and four grounded mounting/test pads.
Firmware assignments: USB on PA24/PA25; SWD on PA30/PA31; flash CS/MISO/MOSI/SCK on PA08/PA19/PA22/PA23; LED data/enable on PA18/PA15. The Qwiic connector is GND, 3.3 V, SDA/PA16, SCL/PA17. The 1x10 user header is 3.3 V, PA02, PA03, PA04, PA05, PA16, PA17, PA06/TX, PA07/RX, GND. The additional 2x6 header, in pin-number order, is VBUS, PA00, GND, PA01, 3.3 V, PA14, PA09, PA27, PA10, PA28, PA11, RGB data out. Include the optional flash and its pull-ups in the schematic. Use the local flash symbol and card footprints.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library (gd25q16ct.kicad_sym) and footprint library (Microcontroller.pretty) in lib/ under the project directory; use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
